title: ComputeEscrow slash-redistribution integration
purpose: Close the original CMP-1.2 slash-redistribution cross-phase dependency without ever treating payer escrow as slash collateral.
requirements: the harmed payer is derived only from canonical ComputeEscrow entitlement/dispute state
the slash recipient resolver freezes the exact entitlement endpoint and runtime code hash
entitlement endpoint or runtime drift fails closed
objective finalized verifier-error dispute state is required before canonical payer resolution
recipient resolution is read-only and cannot mutate payer Vault balances, obligations or accounting
actual redistributed value originates only from objectively forfeited CMP-1.5 worker/verifier collateral
payer escrow deposits, payer safety obligations, provider obligations and refund obligations are never slash sources
slash recipient addresses are frozen in the slash authorization before distribution
later escrow/resolver state cannot redirect an already-authorized distribution
the original CMP-1.2 slash-redistribution repository blocker is resolved without claiming live deployment
CMP-1.2.9 remains the live deployment blocker
security_boundaries: no payer escrow debit or cancellation is introduced by this step
no slash authority is granted to ComputeEscrow
no settlement/refund authority is granted to ComputeStake
no arbitrary caller selects the harmed payer
a paid/missing entitlement claim cannot be used as the harmed-payer source
resolver runtime and entitlement runtime drift fail closed
live stake slashing remains unclaimed until testnet deployment evidence exists

milestone.rationale: CMP-1.5.10 closes the cross-phase economic boundary between CMP-1.2 payer accounting and CMP-1.5 collateral redistribution.

level_1_required: focused canonical escrow payer recipient-resolution tests
